description.value: Tanlu Grill is a Northeastern Chinese charcoal BBQ restaurant located in Richmond's Garden City area, carrying on generations-old grilling traditions centred on quality meats cooked tableside over live charcoal. The concept draws on a heritage spanning both China and the diaspora, positioning itself as a social fine-dining experience with sizzling grilled meats and cold beer. A touring cyclist heading to or from Richmond can expect a sit-down dinner destination with a distinctly immersive atmosphere.
